sections.title: WHOAMI
bio: Hi, I'm Samrat Kumar Das from Kolkata, West Bengal.
I'm in the 4th year of my B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering.
I believe nothing is impossible if you think it is possible.
Currently I'm enhancing my skills in Machine Learning and Front-End Development, which I want to pursue further. I love to work as a team and collaborate on open source.
Now I'm looking for an internship to apply and sharpen the skills I'm learning through my studies and personal projects.
